made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/frutas-sheet-make.js, from frutas-set.html (window.FRUTAS.CF, colmado-fuera.js) and the design of Las frutas. A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX, OY = H / 2 + originY. A box is the screen bounding box of its 8 projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels. The front wall of the shop is y = 0 (it faces +y); the pavement runs from it to y = 4.3
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the pavement; z 0.7: the ledge's top; z 0.34: the low crate's top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty: the lowest drawn row is 54); abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30, drawn rows 0 to 49; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (so row 25 of the canvas is on sy); the goat (a new sprite, about 30 x 24 px): its middle column on sx, its bottom edge on sy; in the pose with its neck stretched down its head is at cabra.cajon (the goat's feet stay on cabra.poste); a small thing: its bottom middle on the point; things of a row (monedas4, monedas2): the first one's bottom middle on the point, the next ones on the points .2 on along dir
rules.view: a view has a zoom (here 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture) and x0 = clamp(round(sx - 98), 0, 44), sx the projection of its world point. Never a fraction
rules.person: for the check "shows enough above the stand's back board": don Pepe is 53 rows tall (mkPersona standing), at least 24 of them above the board's top edge at his column
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character. Except plato and aguja, which have drawn_depth too: the set draws the scale (dial, pan, chains) at the dial's depth + .3, nearer than their world points, so a sprite on them (the needle, what lies on the pan) must use drawn_depth in front.plane or the scale's own pixels hide it
rules.footprints: what the check "frog-places" takes the small things on the ledge to cover (their stand-ins in frutas-preview.html; the final art may differ): a coin 7 x 7 px; a crate 0.7 x 0.3 x 0.34 (world x, y, z: .7 wide as the design says, a ledge's depth less a hair, as high as the low crate); the basket 0.9 x 0.3 x 0.3; each box is the screen box of the thing's projected corners standing on the ledge's top at its point, the frog's is his drawn box (30 x 24)

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3), so the stand hides don Pepe behind it up to his waist, the bins and the ledge hide nothing that stands in front of them, and the goat is drawn in front of its post (the post is a hair nearer than the goat's feet, less than the .3).
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as El mostrador's sheet: the upright plane through the feet; the same test for people, the goat and the things on the ledge
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the pavement (z 0)
shadows.onLedge: the frog on the ledge casts none: the ledge is not ground (a shadow cast at the pavement under him would show in front of the stand)
